description.value: Bourbon Street Bar & Grill is a casual full-service restaurant located inside the Prestige Inn in Vernon, B.C., offering an 'Okanagan Casual with a Creole Twist' menu that blends local Okanagan ingredients with Southern Creole-inspired cooking. The restaurant is run by an owner with over 30 years in the hospitality industry and is noted for weekly live blues nights and a Sunday brunch buffet. Dine-in and takeout are both available, making it a viable resupply stop for cyclists passing through Vernon.
